City - Canyon Valley

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Back to index

Location Profile

Biome identity: cliff roads, rope bridges, switchback caravan yards, river-bottom markets, echo inns, gorge rail trestles, wind shelters, pulley lifts, and canyon rescue posts.

Market structure: district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule: Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

Strict Placement Rules

  • Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls.
  • Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces.
  • Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths.
  • Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists.
  • Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards.
  • Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters.
  • Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

DM Use Notes

Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.

All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.
